purpose: Trace-only and scalar-fusion diagnostics: original aggregate results, recovered execution procedures, and dated environment observations.
release_scope: Aggregate records and documentation only; no private inputs, individual predictions, model weights, or new experiment execution.
source_path_basis: Paths identify archived sources relative to the research project, not runnable paths promised inside the public package.
source_hash_semantics: Snapshot hashes identify inspected source files. Recovered execution-source records and their byte comparisons are identified explicitly in the relevant diagnostic sections.

e_only_same_day.copy_policy: Original CSV copied unchanged, retaining all five aggregate diagnostic rows.

sources.role: Cohort, field identifiers, coefficients, and private cache fingerprint

cohort.time_window: May-June test pool as described by the manuscript

e_only_same_day.interpretation: The two tested restricted trace-only scores do not reproduce headline performance; this does not exclude every possible E-only scorer. Extra archived CSV diagnostics are retained as provenance, not new experiments.

manuscript_procedure_alignment.training: Class-balanced logistic model fitted on January-April rows.
manuscript_procedure_alignment.nontrace_first: Trace-absent candidates rank before trace members.
manuscript_procedure_alignment.tie_breaking: Fixed label-independent hash of query and article identifiers; private-data diagnostic only, not the MIND tie procedure.
manuscript_procedure_alignment.corroboration: The recovered executed command confirms class-balanced fitting, the date partition, and the exact label-independent SHA-256 tie procedure.

recovered_execution.source_copy_policy: Exact Python heredoc body recovered from the archived successful execution command, with its trailing newline preserved. The file is an archived research-root script, not a synthetic-data quick-start entry point.
recovered_execution.input_requirement: A trusted, authorized private feature-frame pickle at the original research-relative path; no private frame is distributed.

temporal_partition.actual_branch: date (no split column in the executed input)

recovered_execution.preprocessing: Numeric conversion with nonnumeric/missing input values filled with zero; no feature standardization before logistic fitting.

reference_defaults.basis: Defaults inspected in scikit-learn 1.5.2 on 2026-10-26; the archived command leaves these parameters implicit. Historical version observations are separately dated under runtime_evidence.

tie_breaking.ordering: descending adjusted score, pandas stable mergesort
tie_breaking.distinction: This is the trace-only diagnostic procedure, not the integer-mixing tie rule used by other private ranking runners.

recovered_execution.evaluation: Within-query ranking; NDCG@10, Recall@10, and reciprocal rank of the first positive, averaged over queries with at least one positive.

scalar_oof.documentation_basis: Source snapshots, recovered launch and completion records, verified pre-launch run_core.py bytes, selected aggregate configurations, and dated runtime observations.

source_snapshots.role: Scalar fuser, OOF assembly, and ordinary downstream grid
No-E field filter, fuser, and OOF assembly

runtime_evidence.evidence_type: Dated interpreter/package observations from archived command outputs.
runtime_evidence.runtime_identifier: Anaconda Python installation used by the corrected-core launch command; the same executable was resolved by the E-only-day shell check.

observations.basis: Version query through the Anaconda interpreter, one day before the corrected-core run.
Interpreter path and three package versions printed in the same command output.
Shell-resolved python path and scikit-learn version, on the E-only execution date.

runtime_evidence.interpretation: The observations identify the scientific runtime at the stated dates and corroborate the recorded execution commands. They are dated environment observations, not a dependency lockfile captured inside each training process; the exact historical Python build is not pinned by these outputs.

release_interpretation: The recorded procedures, aggregate outputs, and source checks support the documented private-data diagnostics. Historical runtime observations retain their dates and are kept distinct from source-byte comparisons. No metrics, confidence intervals, or manuscript conclusions were changed by this documentation update.
